title: 第1章 剑眉星目第2章 先把衣服扔海里
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: 奥伦达王国。
灰鸥港的冬天，总是带着一股子透进骨头缝里的湿冷。
海风卷着码头特有的死鱼烂虾味，拼命往破草棚里钻。
苏璃蜷缩在一张发黑的草席上。
他老了。
七十岁的身体像一台生锈报废的机器，每一个零件都在发出最后的哀鸣。
周围躺着几个同樣衣衫褴褛的老苦力。
没人看他。
在这个地方，死人好像比死鱼还常见。
除了少个干活的，地球照样转。
苏璃费劲地喘了一口气。
他并不觉得害怕。
终于要解脱了。
再也不用在那该死的跳板上，扛着两百斤的麻袋，为了两个铜板把腰压断。
再也不用去抢发霉的黑面包，还得像狗一样把上面长毛的部分啃掉。
这操蛋的一生。
苏璃模糊的视线穿过草棚的破洞，看着灰蒙蒙的天空。
五十年了。
他还记得刚穿越那天。
那时候他十八岁，穿着t恤牛仔裤，一脸懵逼地站在灰鸥港的码头。
结果呢？
话还没说两句，就被一队全副武装的卫兵按在地上摩擦。
理由很简单。
奇装异服，语言不通。
敌国间谍实锤了。
要不是那时候奥伦达王国跟邻国打仗打疯了，前线急缺填线宝宝，他那天就得挂在绞刑架上随风飘扬。
后来呢？
后来他就成了光荣的苦力。
从战场侥幸没死，又被卖回码头。
整整五十年。
他学会了这里的通用语，学会了怎么看贵族老爷的脸色，学会了怎么在发霉食物里找吃的。
唯独没学会怎么翻身。
没金手指，没老爷爷，没退婚流。
只有搬不完的砖，和挨不完的打。
“这穿越……太给穿越者丢脸了……”
苏璃嘟囔了一句。
声音小得连他自己都听不清。
content_en:
Kingdom of Orenda.
Winter in Gray Gull Harbor always brings a dampness and coldness that penetrates into the bones.
The sea breeze carried the unique smell of dead fish and rotten shrimps at the pier, and he tried his best to crawl into the broken thatched hut.
Su Li huddled on a black straw mat.
He is old.
The seventy-year-old body is like a rusty and scrapped machine, with every part emitting its final cry.
Lying around were a few old coolies in the same ragged clothes.
No one looked at him.
In this place, dead people seem to be more common than dead fish.
Except there are fewer people working, the earth is still turning.
Su Li took a hard breath.
He didn't feel scared.
Finally free.
No longer do you have to carry a two-hundred-pound sack on that damn springboard and break your waist for two copper coins.
No more grabbing moldy brown bread and having to chew off the hairy parts like a dog.
This fucking life.
Su Li's blurred vision passed through the holes in the hut and looked at the gray sky.
Fifty years.
He still remembered the day he first crossed over.
He was eighteen years old at the time, wearing a T-shirt and jeans, standing at the dock of Gray Gull Harbor with a confused look on his face.
The result?
Before he could say a few words, he was pushed to the ground and rubbed by a group of heavily armed guards.
The reason is simple.
Strange clothes, language barrier.
The enemy's spy is real.
If Orenda Kingdom hadn't gone crazy at war with neighboring countries at that time, and the front line was in urgent need of fill-in babies, he would have been hanging on the gallows that day and fluttering in the wind.
What happened next?
Later he became a glorious coolie.
Fortunately, he survived the battlefield and was sold back to the dock.
A whole fifty years.
He learned the lingua franca here, learned how to read the expressions of noble lords, and learned how to find something to eat in moldy food.
But I didn't learn how to stand up.
There is no golden finger, no grandpa, no divorce.
There are only endless bricks to move and endless beatings.
"This time travel... is too embarrassing for the time travellers..."
Su Li muttered.
The voice was so low that even he himself couldn't hear it clearly.
